description: This file defines data models and a fetcher class for Tradier equity quotes, including query parameters, data validation, and data transformation logic.

classes.name: TradierEquityQuoteQueryParams
classes.description: Model for Tradier-specific equity quote query parameters, extending general equity quote query parameters with support for multiple symbols.

classes.name: TradierEquityQuoteData
classes.description: Model for Tradier equity quote data, including fields for options and greeks, with validation and date parsing.

classes.name: TradierEquityQuoteFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class for retrieving Tradier equity quotes, including methods for transforming queries, fetching data asynchronously, and processing raw data into models.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a TradierEquityQuoteQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches raw quote data from the Tradier API using provided credentials and query parameters.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API response data into validated TradierEquityQuoteData instances, handling nested greeks and exchange mappings.

methods.name: validate_dates
methods.description: Validates and converts date fields from timestamps or strings into timezone-aware datetime objects.

methods.name: normalize_percent
methods.description: Normalizes percentage values by dividing by 100.

methods.name: replace_zero
methods.description: Replaces zero values in data with None for cleaner data handling.
